scripts.build: npm run build:lib && tsc && vite build
scripts.test: npm run build:lib && cargo test --manifest-path src/lib/core/Cargo.toml && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsx test/offline.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:lib && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsx --import ./test/support/register-shim.mjs --experimental-wasm-jspi test/e2e.test.ts
